summary: First testing run for the Galaxy Salon platform. Backend: 50/50 pytest cases pass end-to-end covering root/business/hero/categories/services/employees/gallery/testimonials/faqs, availability (valid/past/bad/unknown), booking creation + duplicate-slot 409 + mock payment verify + confirmation, admin login/me/guards, admin stats/bookings (list/filter/search/patch)/customers/business/generic CRUD for 7 collections. Frontend: landing page renders (hero, Book CTA, footer, FAQ accordion). Full booking wizard (Category → Service → Professional → Date → Time → Details → Review → Payment) completes and lands on /booking/:id with GX booking code (e.g., GXATYUZ5). Admin login → dashboard renders 4 KPI cards + recent bookings; sidebar nav to bookings/services/employees/customers/content/settings all work; Content page shows all 4 tabs; logout returns to /admin/login; invalid credentials produces the expected error toast.

issues: DatePicker uses d.toISOString().slice(0,10) to generate the calendar day value. For timezones east of UTC (e.g., IST) this converts the local date to the previous day when the local hour is early enough, which can cause the ISO passed to /api/availability to be one day earlier than what the user visually picked. Not observed to fail in this run (tested with days +5) but is a latent bug worth noting.

action_items: (Optional) Fix Booking.jsx DatePicker to build the ISO date from local components (year/month/day) instead of toISOString() to avoid timezone off-by-one on the calendar-to-availability call.

(Optional) Add data-testid to the admin login error message container (e.g., data-testid="login-error") to make invalid-credentials assertion more robust in future tests. Currently the error surfaces via a Sonner toast which is not tagged.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:44 clean() mutates the passed dict by popping _id. Not returning issue in most flows since it's already stripped by projection, but avoid mutating caller-owned dicts.

server.py:593 create_booking calls availability() as a plain function; since availability is decorated with @api.get it may be safer to extract slot-computation into a helper. It works today because FastAPI leaves the coroutine callable but couples booking logic to the route handler.

server.py:701 admin_login accepts case-insensitive email but stores exact-case; a user seeded via env with mixed case could still be found on the fallback path — acceptable, but consider normalizing on seed.

server.py:790 _make_admin_crud does not validate payloads (accepts any Dict[str, Any]) — no type coercion or restriction. Attackers with admin token could insert arbitrary fields; low risk given admin-only, but consider Pydantic models per collection.
server.py DatePicker off-by-one: matching backend uses `datetime.strptime(date, ...)` so any timezone drift on the FE side would surface as 400/404 or empty slots.
Frontend Booking.jsx DatePicker: uses toISOString().slice(0,10) which is UTC — see design_issues above.
AdminDashboard.jsx: data-testid uses computed label including apostrophes and spaces (e.g., stat-today's-bookings). Works, but consider stable slugs like stat-today-bookings.
seed_data_creation: Tests created TEST_-prefixed bookings/customers/CRUD items and cleaned up CRUD items after each parametrized case. Two bookings and customers with phones +919999900001 and +919888800000 remain (Playwright + pytest); test booking was marked completed in the DB by the admin PATCH test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run backend tests with: `cd /app && python -m pytest backend/tests/test_galaxy_api.py -v --tb=short -n 0 --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. The suite MUST run serially (-n 0) because TestBookingFlow creates state that TestAdminData relies on; with the default -n 2 loadscope, classes run on separate workers and TestAdminData sees an empty bookings collection. Base URL is read from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. RAZORPAY_MODE=mock so /api/payments/verify always confirms. Booking codes look like GX + 6 uppercase alnum.
rca of the issue: No open bugs. During test run, one non-issue observed: pytest ran in parallel (xdist) by default (see /app/backend/pytest.ini), causing test-ordering flakes across classes because TestBookingFlow creates data that TestAdminData asserts against. Fix is to run with -n 0 (serial). Confirmed all 50 tests pass serially.
